title: Quest Progression Planner
summary: Use prerequisites, unlock requirements, maps, and rewards to choose the next useful quest from 85 tracked quests.
content:
What To Check First

  • Open the Quest tab and check prerequisites before chasing a late-chain objective.
  • Prioritize quests that unlock a map, useful key, blueprint, weapon, or defensive item.
  • Group quests by map so one deployment can progress several tasks.
  • Do delivery objectives last if carrying the item makes the raid riskier.

title: Map Unlocks And Routing
summary: Plan routes around map availability and objective location instead of reading long generic walkthroughs.
content:
Unlock Requirements

  • Dam Battlegrounds: 起始區域
  • Blue Gate: 已進行18輪
  • Stella Montis: 已進行24輪

Routing Rules

  • Run Any-location objectives while farming common materials or clearing simple combat tasks.
  • Save map-specific delivery and search objectives for raids where that map is already your main target.
  • When several quests point to the same map, sort them by risk: visit, search, interact, photograph, then deliver.
  • Current quest data references these location groups: 任意, 太空港, 水壩戰場, 掩埋之城, 藍門, Blue Gate and 星山.
author: ARC Companion Team

title: Reward Planning
summary: Use quest rewards to decide which objectives are worth doing before crafting, fighting, or upgrading.
content:
Reward Priority

  • Blueprints and keys usually change what you can craft or access, so treat them as high-priority rewards.
  • Ammo, grenades, shields, and healing rewards are best claimed before harder combat quests.
  • Material rewards are useful when they shorten a workbench upgrade or weapon craft.
  • Cosmetic rewards can wait unless the quest is already on your planned route.
author: ARC Companion Team

title: Materials And Inventory
summary: The local item database tracks 533 items, including 44 material entries, 46 quick-use items, and 75 weapons.
content:
Before A Raid

  • Search the item database before deploying for a delivery quest so you know the exact icon and item name.
  • Put rare quest items in safe storage until the quest explicitly asks you to deliver them.
  • Keep common materials only when they match active objectives, crafting plans, or upgrades.
  • If you are carrying a quest item, choose extraction over optional fights.
author: ARC Companion Team

title: Combat Objectives
summary: Handle ARC kill and loot objectives by preparing the right weapon, escape route, and delivery plan.
content:
Combat Checklist

  • Read whether the objective asks you to destroy, loot, photograph, or deliver ARC parts.
  • Do not start heavy ARC fights while carrying unrelated delivery items.
  • Bring enough ammo for the target and keep one escape path open before shooting.
  • If a quest asks for enemy drops, extract after the drop is secured instead of pushing another fight.
author: ARC Companion Team

title: Search And Photo Objectives
summary: Photo, search, and interaction tasks are easiest when you treat them as route goals, not loot detours.
content:
Fast Completion Rules

  • Reach the named landmark first, then loot only nearby containers that match the objective text.
  • For photo tasks, clear immediate threats before opening the camera interaction.
  • For computer, terminal, switch, or repair tasks, listen for other Raiders before starting the interaction.
  • If an objective says in one round, avoid splitting it across raids; finish every listed step before extracting.
author: ARC Companion Team
